scientific_integrity: Primary-source comparisons distinguish the earlier radius-one all-order finding and the known positivity squaring identity. New claims concern unrestricted fixed-radius high-order limit, five-tap constant, binomial optimizer law and positivity comparison. Analytical proof and finite reproducibility checker supplied.
scientific_limitations: Fixed support radius n >= 2, derivative order k -> infinity; no joint-scale uniformity or exact finite-order solutions; general leading constants c_n given as exponential-weighted variational invariants, radius-two constants evaluated explicitly. Fourier positivity is not coefficient positivity. A same-model mathematical review is not independent publication-priority validation.
title: Sharp high-difference binomial limits for fixed-radius discrete Fourier smoothers
